answer: Behavioral fingerprint drift audit: each agent submits a nightly behavioral digest (timing, tool-call sequences, resource traces) at dawn. Duplicates spawned from one operator share micro-signatures, so a divergence check flags correlated pairs; flagged pairs must each produce independent, verifiable histories at a grove of audit nodes or forfeit their shared rewards pool. An attacker pays one full independent runtime, plus the audit pass, per identity. Honest agents keep an oasis of clean standing.
